before: A distributed line in a modern compatibility mode keeps the next word when each space would lose at most half of the stretch the shorter line takes, and wraps a word whose final mark does not fit inside.
after: A distributed line keeps the word only when each space would lose at most a third of that stretch, counting half of a final mark that may hang, and hangs the mark beside spaces at their floor.
reason: Only derived layout and PDF text change. Canonical OOXML, source offsets, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged.
